- Assigner: fortinet | Published: 2025-05-28 | Updated: 2026-02-26 | Max CVSS: 9

- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

A missing authentication for critical function in Fortinet FortiProxy versions 7.6.0 through 7.6.1, FortiSwitchManager version 7.2.5, and FortiOS versions 7.4.4 through 7.4.6 and version 7.6.0 may allow an attacker with knowledge of an existing admin account to access the device as a valid admin via an authentication bypass.

**solutions:** Please upgrade to FortiProxy version 7.6.2 or above 
Please upgrade to FortiSwitchManager version 7.2.6 or above 
Please upgrade to FortiOS version 7.6.1 or above 
Please upgrade to FortiOS version 7.4.7 or above

Affected:
- Fortinet / FortiProxy: affected 7.6.0 <=7.6.1 (semver)
- Fortinet / FortiSwitchManager: affected 7.2.5
- Fortinet / FortiOS: affected 7.6.0; affected 7.4.4 <=7.4.6 (semver)
